gaps.sentence: I'll take the job ___ they don't offer me any more money.
gaps.explanation: 'Even if' concedes a future possibility that will not change the decision.

gaps.sentence: He went back inside, ___ the danger.
gaps.explanation: 'Despite the danger' — noun phrase; although needs a clause.

gaps.sentence: ___ the price, the location is absolutely perfect.
gaps.explanation: 'Apart from the price' = the only negative in an otherwise positive description.

gaps.sentence: ___ she now lives in Oslo, she still supports the Dublin club.
gaps.explanation: 'Although' introduces the contrasting clause; 'despite' needs a noun phrase.

gaps.sentence: The drug trial was halted ___ an irregularity in the data.
gaps.explanation: 'Owing to' + noun phrase gives the reason in formal register.

gaps.sentence: ___ did he apologise, but he also refunded the full amount.
gaps.explanation: 'Not only did he..., but he also...' is the correlative pattern with inversion.

gaps.sentence: The ferry was cancelled; ___, we drove the long way round.
gaps.explanation: 'Consequently' introduces the consequence of the cancellation.

gaps.sentence: The lecture was dull; ___, the students stayed awake out of politeness.
